info.title: ApiToolKit - Shopee Open API
info.description: ASP.NET Core MVC integration for all Shopee Open Platform APIs. Covers Auth, Shop, Product, Order, Logistics, Voucher, Discount, Media, Merchant, Return, Payment, Bundle Deal, Add-on Deal, Shop Flash Sale, Top Picks, Shop Category, Public, First Mile, Push Notification, Account Health, SBS, FBS, Global Product, Ads, Follow Prize, Video, Livestream, and AMS modules.
